description.en: The URL or IP address of the monitoring task.

description.zh: 报警规则ID。云监控中已存在的报警规则ID，可通过DescribeMetricRuleList接口查询，请参见[DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~)。
description.en: The ID of the alert rule. The ID of an existing alert rule in CloudMonitor. You can call the DescribeMetricRuleList operation to query alert rule IDs. For more information, see [DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~).

description.zh: 自定义探测周期。只能选择周一至周日的某个时间段进行探测。
description.en: The custom monitoring schedule. You can select a specific time period from Monday to Sunday for monitoring.

description.zh: 监控频率。取值：1、5、15。单位：分钟。默认值：1。
description.en: The monitoring frequency. Valid values: 1, 5, and 15. Unit: minutes. Default value: 1.

description.zh:
监控指标的单位。

单位：毫秒（ms）。
description.en:
The unit of the monitoring metrics.

Unit: milliseconds (ms).

description.zh:
探针信息。格式为JSONArray，例如：`[{"city":"546","isp":"465"},{"city":"572","isp":"465"},{"city":"738","isp":"465"}]`，`city`分别对应北京、杭州和青岛。

> 您可以通过DescribeSiteMonitorISPCityList接口获取探测点信息，请参见[DescribeSiteMonitorISPCityList](~~115045~~)。如果该参数取值为空，则系统随机选择3个探测点。
description.en:
The detection point information. The value is in JSONArray format, for example: `[{"city":"546","isp":"465"},{"city":"572","isp":"465"},{"city":"738","isp":"465"}]`, where `city` corresponds to Beijing, Hangzhou, and Qingdao respectively.

> You can call the DescribeSiteMonitorISPCityList operation to query detection point information. For more information, see [DescribeSiteMonitorISPCityList](~~115045~~). If this parameter is left empty, the system randomly selects three detection points.

description.zh: 监控任务对应协议类型的高级扩展选项。不同监控任务的协议类型对应不同的扩展选项。
description.en: The advanced extended options for the protocol type of the monitoring task. Different protocol types correspond to different extended options.
The ID of the monitoring task.

description.zh: 监控任务名称。长度4~100个字符，取值可包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和汉字。
description.en: The name of the monitoring task. The name must be 4 to 100 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and Chinese characters.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms modify-site-monitor --address http://www.aliyun.com --task-id 2c8dbdf9-a3ab-46a1-85a4-f094965e0000 --task-name HanZhou_ECS2 --interval 1 --isp-cities city_:_546_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_572_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_738_,_isp_:_465 --options-json time_out_:5000 --alert-ids 49f7c317-7645-4cc9-94fd-ea42e1220000 --interval-unit ms --custom-schedule start_hour_:0,_end_hour_:24,_days_:_0_,_time_zone_:_Local --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms ModifySiteMonitor --region cn-hangzhou --IntervalUnit ms --CustomSchedule 'start_hour_:0,_end_hour_:24,_days_:_0_,_time_zone_:_Local' --TaskId '2c8dbdf9-a3ab-46a1-85a4-f094965e0000' --Address 'http://www.aliyun.com' --TaskName HanZhou_ECS2 --OptionsJson 'time_out_:5000' --IspCities 'city_:_546_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_572_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_738_,_isp_:_465' --Interval 1 --AlertIds '49f7c317-7645-4cc9-94fd-ea42e1220000'
